_source: A real 'Form 3 Principles of Accounts Scheme of Work, Term 1-3' (Mkushi Boarding Secondary School; the source's own teacher name and Teaching Service number are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project and reviewed in full, covering all three terms. This extends the existing Form 1/Form 2 Principles of Accounts files in this app to Form 3, under the same 2023 Competency-Based Curriculum. The source cites real page numbers from an official Principles of Accounts syllabus throughout (e.g. 'Syllabus p.41', 'Syllabus p.47'), confirming its own topic/sub-topic/outcome numbering (3.1 through 3.5) tracks that official document directly, though this app does not hold that syllabus document itself -- the scheme's own real content (Topic, Sub-topic and Specific Competence statements) is reproduced here; its own Content/Concept and Learning Activities columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app. Term placement for every topic is real, read directly from which Term block of the source document it appears in. Note that the source's own numbering places two distinct topics both under an 'Adjustments to Financial Statements' heading -- 3.1 (accruals, prepayments, bad debts, doubtful debts) in Term 1, and 3.5 (depreciation of non-current assets) in Term 3, with Bank Reconciliation (3.2), Limitations of the Trial Balance (3.3) and Control Accounts (3.4) numbered in between -- reproduced here exactly as the source itself numbers them, with '(Depreciation)' added to 3.5's own topic name only to distinguish the two in this file's listings.
